source_arguments.statement:
theorem onsetPulseTransform_rotated_re (x y : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (-I*(y:ℂ))*onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ))).re =
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1))
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem onsetPulseTransform_rotated_re (x y : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (-I*(y:ℂ))*onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ))).re =
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let f := fun u : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition u:ℝ):ℂ)*
    Complex.exp (((x*u:ℝ):ℂ)+I*((y*(u-1):ℝ):ℂ))
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_deriv_smoothTransition).mul (by fun_prop)
  have he : Complex.exp (-I*(y:ℂ))*onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ)) =
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, f u := by
    unfold onsetPulseTransform
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr
    intro u _
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [mul_left_comm,← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hr := Complex.reCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 1 (μ := volume))
  change (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, (f u).re) = (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, f u).re at hr
  rw [← hr]
  apply integral_congr
  intro u _
  dsimp only [f]
  simp [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.exp_re,mul_assoc]

source_arguments.name: RHTower.D4BMModularCore.onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_re_pos
source_arguments.statement: theorem onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_re_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < (onsetPulseTransform (x:ℂ)).re
source_arguments.source_statement: theorem onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_re_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < (onsetPulseTransform (x:ℂ)).re
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rw [onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_eq, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hm0 : 0 < min 1 (Real.exp x) := lt_min one_pos (Real.exp_pos x)
  have hχ' : ∀ u, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition u :=
    fun _ => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hexp : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := by
    intro u hu
    rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
    · calc min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
        _ = Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_zero.symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [hu.1])
    · calc min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ Real.exp x := min_le_right _ _
        _ ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [hu.1, hu.2])
  have hlow : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * min 1 (Real.exp x)) ≤
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * Real.exp (x * u) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
    · exact (continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · exact (continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul (by fun_prop)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · intro u hu
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hexp u hu) (hχ' u)
  have hval : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * min 1 (Real.exp x)) =
      min 1 (Real.exp x) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, integral_deriv_eq_sub]
    · simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
    · intro u _
      exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)) u
    · exact continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  linarith

source_arguments.name: RHTower.D4BMModularCore.onsetPulseTransform_sub
source_arguments.statement:
theorem onsetPulseTransform_sub (v w : ℂ) :
    onsetPulseTransform (v - w) = 1 + (w - v) * onsetCorrection v w
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem onsetPulseTransform_sub (v w : ℂ) :
    onsetPulseTransform (v - w) = 1 + (w - v) * onsetCorrection v w
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hu : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ((Real.smoothTransition u : ℂ) - 1))
      ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) x := fun x _ => hasDerivAt_transition_sub_one x
  have hv : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp ((v - w) * (u:ℂ)))
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) x := fun x _ => hasDerivAt_exp_ray (v - w) x
  have hcχ : Continuous fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_deriv_smoothTransition
  have hce : Continuous fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)) := by fun_prop
  have hu' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume 0 1 :=
    hcχ.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hv' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul hce).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have key := integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub hu hv hu' hv'
  have hA : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) volume 0 1 := (hcχ.mul hce).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hB : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) volume 0 1 :=
    (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp Real.smoothTransition.continuous).sub continuous_const).mul
      (continuous_const.mul hce)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  rw [integral_add hA hB] at key
  have hbd : ((Real.smoothTransition (1:ℝ) : ℂ) - 1) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * ((1:ℝ):ℂ)) -
      ((Real.smoothTransition (0:ℝ) : ℂ) - 1) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * ((0:ℝ):ℂ)) = 1 := by
    simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
  have key2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) +
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
        ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) = 1 := by
    exact key.trans hbd
  have hB' : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) = (v - w) * onsetCorrection v w := by
    rw [onsetCorrection, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr
    intro x _
    ring
  rw [hB'] at key2
  unfold onsetPulseTransform
  linear_combination key2

/-- The derivative-pulse transform is entire. -/
theorem differentiable_onsetPulseTransform : Differentiable ℂ onsetPulseTransform := by
  have he : onsetPulseTransform = fun z => 1 - z * onsetCorrection 0 (-z) :=
    funext onsetPulseTransform_eq_one_sub
  rw [he]
  exact (differentiable_const (1:ℂ)).sub
    (differentiable_id.mul ((onsetCorrection_entire 0).comp differentiable_neg))

theorem analyticOnNhd_onsetPulseTransform : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ onsetPulseTransform univ :=
  Complex.analyticOnNhd_univ_iff_differentiable.mpr differentiable_onsetPulseTransform

/-- Along any ray of exponents the pulse transform has only isolated zeros. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_ray_eventually_ne_zero (z₀ L₀ : ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ L in 𝓝[≠] L₀, onsetPulseTransform (L * z₀) ≠ 0 := by
  have hd : Differentiable ℂ (fun L : ℂ => onsetPulseTransform (L * z₀)) :=
    differentiable_onsetPulseTransform.comp (differentiable_id.mul_const z₀)
  have ha : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun L : ℂ => onsetPulseTransform (L * z₀)) univ :=
    Complex.analyticOnNhd_univ_iff_differentiable.mpr hd
  rcases (ha L₀ (mem_univ _)).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with h | h
  · exfalso
    have h0 := ha.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero isPreconnected_univ
      (mem_univ L₀) h (mem_univ (0:ℂ))
    simp [onsetPulseTransform_zero] at h0
  · exact h

/-- Every real duration has arbitrarily close real durations with nonzero transform. -/
theorem exists_real_near_onsetPulseTransform_ne_zero (z₀ : ℂ) (L₀ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, |L - L₀| < ε ∧ L ≠ L₀ ∧ onsetPulseTransform ((L:ℂ) * z₀) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhdsWithin_iff.mp
    (onsetPulseTransform_ray_eventually_ne_zero z₀ (L₀:ℂ))
  have hm0 : 0 < min δ ε := lt_min hδ hε
  refine ⟨L₀ + min δ ε / 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    linarith [min_le_right δ ε]
  · intro h
    linarith
  · apply hball
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, Complex.dist_eq, ← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, add_sub_cancel_left,
        abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith [min_le_left δ ε]
    · simp only [mem_compl_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
      intro h
      have h' := Complex.ofReal_inj.mp h
      linarith

/-- At a real exponent the transform is the real derivative-pulse integral. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_eq (x : ℝ) :
    onsetPulseTransform (x:ℂ) =
      ((∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * Real.exp (x * u) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  unfold onsetPulseTransform
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  apply integral_congr
  intro u _
  push_cast
  ring

/-- At a real exponent the transform is strictly positive. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_re_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < (onsetPulseTransform (x:ℂ)).re := by
  rw [onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_eq, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hm0 : 0 < min 1 (Real.exp x) := lt_min one_pos (Real.exp_pos x)
  have hχ' : ∀ u, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition u :=
    fun _ => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hexp : ∀ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1, min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := by
    intro u hu
    rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
    · calc min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
        _ = Real.exp 0 := Real.exp_zero.symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [hu.1])
    · calc min 1 (Real.exp x) ≤ Real.exp x := min_le_right _ _
        _ ≤ Real.exp (x * u) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [hu.1, hu.2])
  have hlow : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * min 1 (Real.exp x)) ≤
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * Real.exp (x * u) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
    · exact (continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · exact (continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul (by fun_prop)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    · intro u hu
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hexp u hu) (hχ' u)
  have hval : (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u * min 1 (Real.exp x)) =
      min 1 (Real.exp x) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, integral_deriv_eq_sub]
    · simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
    · intro u _
      exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)) u
    · exact continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  linarith

theorem onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_ne_zero (x : ℝ) : onsetPulseTransform (x:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hp := onsetPulseTransform_ofReal_re_pos x
  rw [h] at hp
  simp at hp

end
end RHTower.D4BMModularCore

/-!
# The onset derivative-pulse transform

`onsetCorrection v w = ∫_{0}^{1} (χ(u) - 1) e^{(v-w)u} du` with `χ = Real.smoothTransition`.
One integration by parts gives

`1 + (w - v) * onsetCorrection v w = ∫_{0}^{1} χ'(u) e^{(v-w)u} du`.

The right-hand side is the Laplace transform of the onset derivative pulse at exponent `v - w`.
It is an entire function of the exponent with value `1` at exponent `0`.  Hence along every ray
`L ↦ L * z₀` of exponents its zeros are isolated, and at real exponents it is strictly positive.

This isolates the onset factor of the fundamental Laurent coefficient; it evaluates no physical
source and proves no extinction.
-/

open MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology intervalIntegral
open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry
namespace RHTower.D4BMModularCore
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-- Laplace transform of the onset derivative pulse at exponent `z`. -/
def onsetPulseTransform (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, ((deriv Real.smoothTransition u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (z * (u:ℂ))

private theorem hasDerivAt_transition_sub_one (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ((Real.smoothTransition u : ℂ) - 1))
      ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) x := by
  have h : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition x) x :=
    (((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)) x).hasDerivAt
  exact h.ofReal_comp.sub_const 1

private theorem hasDerivAt_exp_ray (z : ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (z * (u:ℂ))) (z * Complex.exp (z * (x:ℂ))) x := by
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => z * y) z (x:ℂ) := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (x:ℂ)).const_mul z
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => Complex.exp (z * y)) (Complex.exp (z * (x:ℂ)) * z) (x:ℂ) :=
    (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (z * (x:ℂ))).comp (x:ℂ) hg
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact h.comp_ofReal

/-- One integration by parts: the cleared onset numerator is the derivative-pulse transform. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_sub (v w : ℂ) :
    onsetPulseTransform (v - w) = 1 + (w - v) * onsetCorrection v w := by
  have hu : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => ((Real.smoothTransition u : ℂ) - 1))
      ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) x := fun x _ => hasDerivAt_transition_sub_one x
  have hv : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp ((v - w) * (u:ℂ)))
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) x := fun x _ => hasDerivAt_exp_ray (v - w) x
  have hcχ : Continuous fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_deriv_smoothTransition
  have hce : Continuous fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)) := by fun_prop
  have hu' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume 0 1 :=
    hcχ.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hv' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) volume 0 1 :=
    (continuous_const.mul hce).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have key := integral_deriv_mul_eq_sub hu hv hu' hv'
  have hA : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) volume 0 1 := (hcχ.mul hce).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hB : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) volume 0 1 :=
    (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp Real.smoothTransition.continuous).sub continuous_const).mul
      (continuous_const.mul hce)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  rw [integral_add hA hB] at key
  have hbd : ((Real.smoothTransition (1:ℝ) : ℂ) - 1) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * ((1:ℝ):ℂ)) -
      ((Real.smoothTransition (0:ℝ) : ℂ) - 1) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * ((0:ℝ):ℂ)) = 1 := by
    simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
  have key2 : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((deriv Real.smoothTransition x : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ))) +
      (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
        ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) = 1 := by
    exact key.trans hbd
  have hB' : (∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, ((Real.smoothTransition x : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((v - w) * Complex.exp ((v - w) * (x:ℂ)))) = (v - w) * onsetCorrection v w := by
    rw [onsetCorrection, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr
    intro x _
    ring
  rw [hB'] at key2
  unfold onsetPulseTransform
  linear_combination key2

theorem onsetPulseTransform_zero : onsetPulseTransform 0 = 1 := by
  have h := onsetPulseTransform_sub 0 0
  simpa using h

theorem onsetPulseTransform_eq_one_sub (z : ℂ) :
    onsetPulseTransform z = 1 - z * onsetCorrection 0 (-z) := by
  have h := onsetPulseTransform_sub 0 (-z)
  rw [zero_sub, neg_neg, sub_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

/-- The derivative-pulse transform is entire. -/
theorem differentiable_onsetPulseTransform : Differentiable ℂ onsetPulseTransform := by

ncy. The duration is unchanged. -/
theorem onsetPulse_phase_integral_eventually_pos (y : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0≤R ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, R≤x →
      0 < ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha0,ha1,hphase⟩ := terminal_phase y
  let b := (a+1)/2
  have hab : a<b := by dsimp only [b]; linarith
  have hb1 : b<1 := by dsimp only [b]; linarith
  let c := 1-Real.smoothTransition b
  have hc : 0<c := sub_pos.mpr (Real.smoothTransition.lt_one_of_lt_one hb1)
  have hδ : 0<b-a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  let R := max 0 ((Real.log (2/c)+1)/(b-a))
  refine ⟨R,le_max_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : 0≤x := (le_max_left _ _).trans hx
  have hlog : Real.log (2/c)<x*(b-a) := by
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp ((le_max_right _ _).trans hx)
    linarith
  have he : 2/c < Real.exp (x*(b-a)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_log (div_pos (by norm_num) hc),Real.exp_lt_exp]
    exact hlog
  have hcprod : 2<c*Real.exp (x*(b-a)) := by simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_lt_iff₀ hc).mp he
  have hexp : Real.exp (x*b)=Real.exp (x*a)*Real.exp (x*(b-a)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hgap : 0 < -Real.exp (x*a)+c*Real.exp (x*b)/2 := by
    rw [hexp]
    have h := mul_pos (Real.exp_pos (x*a)) (sub_pos.mpr hcprod)
    nlinarith only [h]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hgap (pulse_phase_lower a b x y ha0.le hab.le hb1.le hx0 hphase)

/-- Rotating by the actual endpoint phase identifies the retained positive integral. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_rotated_re (x y : ℝ) :
    (Complex.exp (-I*(y:ℂ))*onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ))).re =
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1)) := by
  let f := fun u : ℝ => ((deriv Real.smoothTransition u:ℝ):ℂ)*
    Complex.exp (((x*u:ℝ):ℂ)+I*((y*(u-1):ℝ):ℂ))
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_deriv_smoothTransition).mul (by fun_prop)
  have he : Complex.exp (-I*(y:ℂ))*onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ)) =
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, f u := by
    unfold onsetPulseTransform
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr
    intro u _
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [mul_left_comm,← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hr := Complex.reCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 1 (μ := volume))
  change (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, (f u).re) = (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, f u).re at hr
  rw [← hr]
  apply integral_congr
  intro u _
  dsimp only [f]
  simp [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.exp_re,mul_assoc]

/-- At every fixed imaginary frequency the original unit-duration pulse survives all
sufficiently large real tilts. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_large_re_ne_zero (y : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0≤R ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, R≤x → onsetPulseTransform ((x:ℂ)+I*(y:ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hpos⟩ := onsetPulse_phase_integral_eventually_pos y
  refine ⟨R,hR,fun x hx hz => ?_⟩
  have hp := hpos x hx
  rw [← onsetPulseTransform_rotated_re,hz,mul_zero,Complex.zero_re] at hp
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp

/-- The actual overtone spacing preserves the fixed pulse and eventually avoids its zeros. -/
theorem onsetPulseTransform_overtone_eventually_ne_zero (z : ℂ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → onsetPulseTransform (z+2*(n:ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨R,_,hR⟩ := onsetPulseTransform_large_re_ne_zero z.im
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((R-z.re)/2)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hnn : (N:ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hx : R≤z.re+2*(n:ℝ) := by linarith
  have he : (((z.re+2*(n:ℝ):ℝ):ℂ)+I*(z.im:ℂ))=z+2*(n:ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  simpa only [he] using hR (z.re+2*(n:ℝ)) hx

end

import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.ThetaCuspHawkingBMOnsetPulseTransform

/-! Nonvanishing of the prescribed onset at large real tilts, with its original pulse retained. -/
namespace RHTower.D4BMModularCore
open Complex Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory intervalIntegral
open GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

private theorem transitionPulse_mass (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in a..b, deriv Real.smoothTransition u) =
      Real.smoothTransition b-Real.smoothTransition a := by
  apply integral_deriv_eq_sub
  · intro u _
    exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)) u
  · exact continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.intervalIntegrable a b

private theorem terminal_phase (y : ℝ) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0<a ∧ a<1 ∧ ∀ u ∈ Icc a 1, 1/2 ≤ Real.cos (y*(u-1)) := by
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.cos (y*(u-1))) 1 := by fun_prop
  have he : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in 𝓝 1, 1/2 < Real.cos (y*(u-1)) :=
    hc.eventually (eventually_gt_nhds (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp he
  let d := min (δ/2) (1/2)
  have hd : 0<d := lt_min (half_pos hδ) (by norm_num)
  have hdδ : d<δ := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨1-d,by dsimp only [d]; linarith [min_le_right (δ/2) (1/2)],by linarith,?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hdist : dist u 1 < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.2])]
    linarith [hu.1]
  exact (hball hdist).le

private theorem pulse_phase_lower (a b x y : ℝ)
    (ha : 0≤a) (hab : a≤b) (hb : b≤1) (hx : 0≤x)
    (hc : ∀ u ∈ Icc a 1, 1/2 ≤ Real.cos (y*(u-1))) :
    -Real.exp (x*a)+(1-Real.smoothTransition b)*Real.exp (x*b)/2 ≤
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1)) := by
  let f := fun u : ℝ => deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1))
  have hp : ∀ u, 0≤deriv Real.smoothTransition u :=
    fun _ => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hf : Continuous f := by
    exact (continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul (by fun_prop)).mul (by fun_prop)
  have hleft : -Real.exp (x*a) ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..a, f u := by
    have h := integral_mono_on (μ := volume) ha
      ((continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 a)
      (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 a)
      (show ∀ u ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) a,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*(-Real.exp (x*a)) ≤ f u from by
        intro u hu
        have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.2 hx)
        have hs := Real.neg_one_le_cos (y*(u-1))
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (hp u)
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs
          (mul_nonneg (hp u) (Real.exp_pos (x*u)).le)
        dsimp only [f]
        nlinarith only [h1,h2])
    change (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..a, deriv Real.smoothTransition u*(-Real.exp (x*a))) ≤
      ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..a, f u at h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,transitionPulse_mass,Real.smoothTransition.zero,sub_zero] at h
    have hmass := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.smoothTransition.le_one a))
      (Real.exp_pos (x*a)).le
    nlinarith only [h,hmass]
  have hmid : 0≤∫ u in a..b, f u := by
    apply integral_nonneg hab
    intro u hu
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hp u) (Real.exp_pos (x*u)).le)
      (le_trans (by norm_num) (hc u ⟨hu.1,hu.2.trans hb⟩))
  have hright : (1-Real.smoothTransition b)*Real.exp (x*b)/2 ≤ ∫ u in b..1, f u := by
    have h := integral_mono_on (μ := volume) hb
      ((continuous_deriv_smoothTransition.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable b 1)
      (hf.intervalIntegrable b 1)
      (show ∀ u ∈ Icc b 1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*(Real.exp (x*b)/2) ≤ f u from by
        intro u hu
        have he := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.1 hx)
        have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (hp u)
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc u ⟨hab.trans hu.1,hu.2⟩)
          (mul_nonneg (hp u) (Real.exp_pos (x*u)).le)
        dsimp only [f]
        nlinarith only [h1,h2])
    change (∫ u in b..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition u*(Real.exp (x*b)/2)) ≤
      ∫ u in b..1, f u at h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const,transitionPulse_mass,Real.smoothTransition.one] at h
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hsplit := integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hf.intervalIntegrable a b)
  have hsplit' := integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (hf.intervalIntegrable 0 b) (hf.intervalIntegrable b 1)
  change _ ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1, f u
  linarith only [hleft,hmid,hright,hsplit,hsplit']

/-- The original pulse has strictly positive rotated real part for every sufficiently large
real tilt, at each fixed imaginary frequency. The duration is unchanged. -/
theorem onsetPulse_phase_integral_eventually_pos (y : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0≤R ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, R≤x →
      0 < ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..1,
        deriv Real.smoothTransition u*Real.exp (x*u)*Real.cos (y*(u-1)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha0,ha1,hphase⟩ := terminal_phase y
  let b := (a+1)/2
